scope: Independent source review and synthetic fixtures only; no actual CAL/primary row, label, model, image, mask, prediction or observation payload decoded; no real solver or scorer execution.

findings.topic: Five uniform arms and parent numerical reuse
findings.detail: Declared SAME_FROZEN_E plus two source policies x native/C use frozen V29 _run solver, selector, physical-Q transport, same six-diverse native starts plus own coarse, cached contenders and native endpoints for C via private FunctionType globals. Parent _models is privately rebound to CAL31/G31; score math/reference code is frozen V29. No old global symmetric mask tie or full-pose/TP/top-normal prior is introduced.

New G31/A31 and M31 exporter require new family/profile/noise_population/raw29/source-policy tags. Runtime passes expected_source_policy to A31. Internal v29 task/model keys are explicit wire aliases only; readout adds V31 profile/owner metadata. No V29/V30 fitted noise is relabelled.

Unavailable policy line/tangent model produces G31.empty_geometry_guided_evidence with explicit uniform abstention reason, original source geometry binding, empty groups and gamma0. No old noise or selected actual line substitutes; frozen no-owner prepartial baseline remains exact.

Caller-provided64 lowercase-hex SHA is required before central JSON decode. All prepare/predict/score stages validate exact central arms/profile and all source/input/protected maps. Prepare also requires full OBS central_plan_sha and fitted-model input map central path SHA equal the caller value; prediction/scoring require protocol/declaration same central. CLI has no embedded expected SHA literal or default.

Metadata facade uses pure prepare31 source without changing its globals and exposes observed_anchor_native_ray_observations_v4_31 as OBS. It imports CAL31 controller and M31.CORE is the same G31. INITIAL fixed geometry/source q and trial WD body/channel semantics remain in G31/A31; no new native-ID permutation or e pose candidate is introduced.

FINAL_PROTOCOL and top OBS seal must carry ordered unique238/new profile/raw29; CAL46 and REST192 partition seals must match exact ordered IDs. Task inputs, full observation journal, final protocol and CAL31 model assets/seals are hash bound. Source/input maps merge with conflicts rejected; protected map and source snapshots verified. Row join streams one task+observation and requires original CAL46/TEST49/REMAINDER143 with no dropouts or zero-evidence filtering.

Storage changes only gzip compression1; same finite UTF8 JSON values/order and existing-journal overwrite rejection tested. Top-level _run remains spawn-picklable. Frozen parent prediction uses bounded pending tasks and all5arms/full238 seal. Frozen score refuses reference access before current full prediction seal and zero-failure independent all238 audit; same CAL/TEST/REMAINDER metrics and reference paths retained.
